item.text:
**Overall:** Lula’s 2024 economic staffing looks mostly professionalized rather than patronage-driven. The strongest evidence points to experienced technocrats such as Fernando Haddad, Simone Tebet, and Gabriel Galípolo being used on fiscal and monetary issues, with Lula also telling the team to respect the fiscal framework. The main caveats are Lula’s public pressure on the central bank and market concerns that Galípolo’s proximity to Lula could soften monetary independence. I found no credible 2024 evidence of Lula appointing family members or business partners to top economic posts.

- [Lula approves spending cuts to meet Brazil's fiscal framework, says minister](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-says-government-is-committed-to-fiscal-responsibility-3507587) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-07-03 - Haddad said Lula ordered the economic team to comply with the fiscal framework and approved spending cuts, which is direct evidence that Lula empowered professional fiscal managers rather than ignoring them for short-term popularity. Question IDs: 5B.2, 5B.1

- [Lula will pick central bank chief at the right time, has "many good people"](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/07/16/ainda-nao-tenho-nome-para-presidir-bc-vou-escolher-na-hora-certa-diz-lula.amp.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-07-16 - Lula said he would choose the next central bank head carefully and consult Haddad, which suggests a formal, competence-based selection process rather than a loyalty-only pick. Question IDs: 5B.2

- [Brazil's Lula to nominate Galipolo as central bank chief, says finance minister](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-lula-to-nominate-galipolo-as-cenbank-chief-says-finance-minister-3591764) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-08-28 - Lula chose Gabriel Galípolo, a serving central-bank monetary policy director and former second-in-command at the finance ministry, for the bank’s top job. That is strong evidence for appointing a technically credible economic professional. Question IDs: 5B.2

- [Galipolo, picked to run Brazil's central bank, is heterodox economist](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/galipolo-picked-to-run-brazils-central-bank-is-heterodox-economist-3592136) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-08-28 - Reuters described Galípolo as a 42-year-old economist and noted that, despite market skepticism, he had built credibility through his work with Haddad on the fiscal agenda. This supports a professional-appointment reading, though his heterodox reputation is a mild caveat. Question IDs: 5B.2

- [Brazil Senate confirms Lula's pick for central bank head, Galipolo assures independence](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/lulas-nominee-to-head-brazil-central-bank-emphasizes-freedom-in-decisionmaking-3653485) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-10-08 - Galípolo told senators that Lula had guaranteed him freedom in decision-making. That is direct evidence that Lula was, at least formally, empowering the appointee rather than treating the central bank as a personal office. Question IDs: 5B.2, 4B.10

- [Lula is displeased with the increase in subsidies, says Tebet](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/06/17/lula-esta-mal-impressionado-com-aumento-dos-subsidios-diz-tebet.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-06-17 - Simone Tebet said Lula gave the economic team time to study the numbers and propose solutions after he was shown subsidy growth. That indicates Lula was using economically literate ministers as problem-solvers, not as mere political ornaments. Question IDs: 5B.2, 5B.1

- [Brazilian ministers pledge measures to strengthen fiscal framework](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazilian-ministers-pledge-measures-to-strengthen-fiscal-framework-3691806) - Reuters via Investing.com - 2024-10-30 - Haddad said cabinet negotiations were advancing on measures to strengthen the fiscal framework, showing that Lula’s economic team was still operating as a real policy unit under technocratic leadership. Question IDs: 5B.2, 5B.1

- [Acenos de Lula a Galípolo deixam mercados em alerta sobre futuro da política monetária](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/12/30/acenos-de-lula-a-galipolo-deixam-mercados-em-alerta-sobre-futuro-da-politica-monetaria.htm) - Reuters via UOL - 2024-12-30 - Reuters reported that some investors worried Lula’s closeness to Galípolo could test the central bank’s formal independence. This is the best negative caveat: not proof of cronyism, but evidence that Lula’s preferred appointee was seen as politically close to him. Question IDs: 5B.2

Search gap: I found no credible 2024 evidence that Lula put family members, business partners, or obvious ideological yes-men in top economic posts. The negative evidence is mostly indirect, centered on his public criticism of the central bank, market anxiety about Galípolo’s closeness to Lula, and recurring fiscal pressure.
